name: Generator London
description: Stylish hostel in a converted police station near King's Cross. Social atmosphere with a bar, cafe, and events.
tips: Private rooms available too. Great location near King's Cross and the British Library.

name: Point A Hotel Shoreditch
description: Smart, compact rooms with everything you need in trendy Shoreditch. Modern design, great WiFi, and excellent location.
tips: Rooms are small but perfectly designed. Steps from Shoreditch's best bars and restaurants.

name: hub by Premier Inn Covent Garden
description: Brilliantly located compact hotel right in Covent Garden. Control your room from an app - lights, TV, temperature.
tips: Unbeatable location for West End theatres. Smart tech-enabled rooms. Book early for best rates.

name: The Hoxton Southwark
description: Design-led boutique hotel with a lively lobby, rooftop bar, and excellent on-site dining. Cool, creative atmosphere.
tips: The rooftop restaurant Seabird has stunning views. Walk to Tate Modern, Borough Market, and the South Bank.

name: The Zetter Townhouse Clerkenwell
description: Boutique Georgian townhouse hotel with individually designed rooms full of vintage curiosities. Award-winning cocktail lounge.
tips: The cocktail lounge is one of London's best. Each room is unique. Perfect romantic getaway.

name: citizenM Tower of London
description: High-tech hotel with mood lighting, rain showers, and king-size beds. Stunning views of the Tower of London from the rooftop bar.
tips: The rooftop bar has incredible Tower of London views. Self-check-in kiosks. Great for tech lovers.

name: The Savoy
description: A legendary 5-star hotel on the Strand. Art Deco glamour, impeccable service, and Thames views. London luxury at its finest.
tips: Even if not staying, visit the American Bar for cocktails or book their famous afternoon tea.

name: Claridge's
description: The epitome of London luxury. Art Deco masterpiece in Mayfair with legendary service. The afternoon tea is world-famous.
tips: The Art Deco foyer is worth seeing even if you're not a guest. Afternoon tea here is a bucket-list experience.

name: Shangri-La The Shard
description: London's highest hotel, occupying floors 34-52 of The Shard. Infinity pool with city views. Unforgettable skyline vistas.
tips: The infinity pool on the 52nd floor is London's most spectacular. Bar and lounge on floor 35 open to non-guests.

name: Safestay London Elephant & Castle
description: Modern hostel in a beautifully converted Victorian mansion. Dorms and private rooms with a garden and communal kitchen.
tips: Great budget option with good transport links. The building itself is gorgeous. 10 mins to central London.
